Add the handling you want inside lib: Process Auto-Approve Task before relying on that arm.

While it is pinned, a manual execution reads the sample and never calls the real service - so the run succeeds and proves nothing about your setup. Unpin it once the credentials and bindings are in place.

behaviour.detail: "OPS_CHAT_ID" appears as the fallback branch of an expression. When the upstream field is missing the expression does not fail - it resolves to that literal string and the call is made with it, which reads downstream as a malformed value rather than as missing data.

bindings.title: Import "lib: Post-Process Events" and select it on Offload to Post-Process Sub-workflow
bindings.detail: This template calls a separate workflow named lib: Post-Process Events, and it is included in your download as lib/lib-post-process-events.json. Import that file into n8n first (Workflows -> Import from File), then open Offload to Post-Process Sub-workflow and pick it in the workflowId selector. The selector is empty until you do: a workflow id only exists inside your own instance, so it cannot be set for you.
